keepEnglishOrLoan.note: Established devops terms. Keep the English word, or the loan form the local developer community uses, and stay consistent across every namespace.

style.de: Formal address (Sie). Sentence case for buttons.
style.pt-BR: Brazilian Portuguese, neutral informal (voce form, pronoun dropped where natural). Sentence case.
style.ja: Polite form (desu/masu). No spaces between Japanese words. Keep Latin product terms as written.
style.zh-CN: Simplified Chinese, concise, no spaces between Chinese characters. Keep Latin product terms as written.
style.es: Keep consistent with the existing Spanish files: formal usted, sentence case.

rules: Keep every {{placeholder}} and every numbered or named tag exactly as in English, including names and count.
Never use an em dash or an en dash. Use a comma, period, colon or parentheses.
Translate values only. Do not add, remove or rename keys. Keep key order identical to en.
Destructive actions (delete, remove, revoke, wipe) must stay as unambiguous and as strong as the English.
Labels stay short: roughly no more than 1.5 times the English length for buttons, tabs and column headers.
Plural keys: ja and zh-CN need only _other. fr and pt-BR need _one, _many and _other (copy _other into _many). de and es need _one and _other.
